# Reshape Matrix

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Resize a 2 by 3 matrix to 3 by 2. Preserve cells at their row and column coordinates, drop the third column and fill the additional row with zeros.

## What this example demonstrates

Resize a 2 by 3 matrix to 3 by 2. Preserve cells at their row and column coordinates, drop the third column and fill the additional row with zeros.
